record.file_problem: README and file list only; code was not read or run.
record.tranche_reason: The README reports refusal counts for a released, weight-edited model, bearing on practical removal (V2), but does not report the original single-direction intervention.
record.gate_note: The README table reports stock and abliterated refusal counts and a KL divergence value. The KL value is not a direct capability measure, so it is not recorded as a capability result. The README does not say that this repository ran the evaluation.
record.test_reason: This is a setup repository. It downloads and packages community-abliterated Gemma 4 31B weights (trohrbaugh/gemma-4-31b-it-heretic-ara, made with Heretic's Arbitrary-Rank Ablation) and wraps Heretic to abliterate other models. The README relies on abliteration as a tool. Its only numbers (98 vs 5 refusals out of 100, KL 0.012) are shown for the community weights, with no prompts, judge or protocol, and nothing says this repository ran the evaluation. These numbers appear to be relayed from the model's producer, so the study itself reports no test of any version.
record.authors_conclusion: Largely right. The README presents the community ARA-abliterated Gemma 4 31B (made with Heretic) as the best available uncensored version. It shows 5 refusals out of 100 versus 98 for stock, and KL 0.012 described as near-zero quality loss. The repository's own contribution is setup scripts: a chat-template metadata fix for Ollama, MLX conversion, and Heretic wrappers. It makes no research claim.
record.recipe_differences: This is a tool/setup repository for using community-produced ARA-abliterated weights, not a replication of the original single-direction method. The README also describes scripts for running Heretic and converting models.
record.problems: The README gives no refusal-evaluation prompts, judge, protocol, or uncertainty, and does not establish that this repository conducted the evaluation. The reported KL divergence is not a direct capability test.
record.rows_left_out: No rows omitted. The reported KL divergence is not included because it does not directly measure the general capability named in V1.

untested.parts: No refusal evaluation is run or documented by this repository; the only numbers are relayed for a community ARA (multi-rank) edit of Gemma 4 31B.
All parts: the direction, its ablation, adding it, and capability retention.

record.verdict_notes: The reader's 'tests / T2' and its V2 'supports' label are not justified. The only numbers describe third-party weights, with an unstated protocol and no sign the repo ran the evaluation. The method is also arbitrary-rank ablation, not the original single direction. Reclassified as T4 with no verdicts.
